editor(page).press('ControlOrMeta+End') await editor(page).pressSequentially('\n\n### Live') await expect(p.locator('h3')).toHaveText('Live') await p.locator('pre').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded() await shot(page, '03-preview') }) test('4. clicking a preview checkbox toggles the source', async ({ page }) => { await newNote(page, 'Tasks', 'Intro\n\n- [ ] alpha\n- [x] beta\n - [ ] nested') const boxes expect(boxes.nth(0)).toBeChecked() await boxes.nth(1).click() await expect(editor(page)).toHaveValue('Intro\n\n- [x] alpha\n- [ ] beta\n - [ ] nested') await expect(boxes.nth(1)).not.toBeChecked() // shot(page, '05-search') await page.getByLabel('Search notes').fill('pancakes') await expect(titles(page)).toHaveText(['Recipes']) await expect(marks).toHaveText(['pancakes']) await page.getByLabel('Search notes').fill('nothing-matches') await expect(items(page)).toHaveCount(0) await expect(list(page)).toContainText('No notes match') await page.getByLabel('Search notes').fill('') await expect(items(page)).toHaveCount(4) await expect(marks).toHaveCount(0) }) test('6 & 7. pinned notes first, then newest edited first', async ({ page }) => { await newNote(page, 'A', 'a') await newNote(page, 'B', 'b') await newNote(page, 'C', 'c') await toList(page) await expect(titles(page)).toHaveText(['C', 'B', 'A', 'Welcome']) // Editing A moves it to the top await open(page, 'A') await editor(page).fill('a edited') await toList(page) await expect(titles(page)).toHaveText(['A', 'C', 'B', 'Welcome']) // Pin Welcome (oldest) from the list await page.getByLabel('Pin Welcome').click() await expect(titles(page)).toHaveText(['Welcome', 'A', 'C', 'B']) // Pin B from the editor header await open(page, 'B') await page.getByLabel('Pin note').click() await expect(page.getByLabel('Unpin note')).toBeVisible() await toList(page) // Pinning does not count as an edit: pinned group still sorted by last edit // (B was created after Welcome, so it comes first among the pinned notes) await expect(status).toHaveText('Saving…') await expect(status).toHaveText('Saved') const stored = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('md-notes:v1')) expect(stored).toContain('typing quickly') await shot(page, '08-saved') }) test('9. word count for the open note', async ({ page }) => { await newNote(page, 'Count') const wc = page.getByTestId('word-count') await expect(wc).toHaveText('0 words') await editor(page).fill('# Hello **world**') await expect(wc).toHaveText('2 words') await editor(page).fill('one') await expect(wc).toHaveText('1 word') await editor(page).fill('- [ ] buy milk\n- [x] call [Mom](https://example.com/x)') await expect(wc).toHaveText('4 words') }) test('10. theme toggle is remembered', async ({ page }) => { const html = page.locator('html') await (size.mobile) await items(page).first().click() await shot(page, '10-dark') await toList(page) await page.getByLabel('Switch to light theme').click() await expect(html).not.toHaveClass(/dark/) await page.reload() await expect(html).not.toHaveClass(/dark/) }) test('11. raw HTML in a note cannot run scripts', async ({ page }) => { const dialogs: string[] = [] page.on('dialog', (d) => { dialogs.push(d.message()) void d.dismiss() }) await newNote( page, 'XSS', [ '', '', '', '', '[click me](javascript:window.__xss=5)', '- [ ] ', 'raw link', ].join('\n\n'), ) const p = preview(page) await expect(p).toContainText('') await expect(p.locator('script, img, svg, iframe, [onclick], [onerror], [onload]')).toHaveCount(0) await p.getByText('click me').click() await p.getByText('raw link', { exact: false }).click() await page.waitForTimeout(300) expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __xss?: number }).__xss)).toBeUndefined() expect(dialogs).toEqual([]) // Still safe after reload (rendered from storage) await page.reload() await open(page, 'XSS') await expect(preview(page).locator('script, img, svg, iframe')).toHaveCount(0) expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __xss?: number }).__xss)).toBeUndefined() await shot(page, '11-xss') }) test('12. notes survive a page reload', async ({ page }) => { await newNote(page, 'Persistent', '# Kept\n\n- [ ] item') await preview(page).locator('input[type=checkbox]').click() await expect(page.getByTestId('save-status')).toHaveText('Saved') await page.reload() await toList(page) await expect(titles(page)).toHaveText(['Persistent', 'Welcome']) await open(page, 'Persistent') await expect(editor(page)).toHaveValue('# Kept\n\n- [x] item') // Typing then reloading immediately (before the debounce fires) still saves await editor(page).press('ControlOrMeta+End') await editor(page).pressSequentially(' fast') await page.reload() await open(page, 'Persistent') await expect(editor(page)).toHaveValue('# Kept\n\n- [x] item fast') // Deleted notes stay deleted await page.getByLabel('Delete note').click() await page.getByRole('alertdialog').getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }).click() await page.reload() await toList(page) await expect(titles(page)).toHaveText(['Welcome']) }) }) }

content.text: All tests pass. Checking the screenshots:

Both changes are in. The tests pass, and I checked the result in Chrome at 1280px and 375px wide.

- **Empty list text:** when there are no notes, the note list now says "Nothing here yet. Create your first note."
- **Word count:** it's no longer in the top bar. It now sits in a small row under the Markdown editor, aligned to the right. On mobile that puts it between the editor and the preview. "Saving…/Saved" stays in the top bar.

I only changed the list's empty text. On desktop, the editor area still shows its own separate message, "You have no notes yet." with a "Create a note" button. I can make that match if you'd like.

**What I checked**
- **Logic tests:** all 42 pass, and the code type-checks.
- **Browser tests:** all 22 pass, 11 at each width. I updated two of them:
  - the delete test now expects the new empty-list text after the last note is deleted;
  - the word-count test now also checks that the count sits just below the editor at its right edge and is no longer in the top bar.
- **Screenshots at both widths:**
  - the empty list shows the new text;
  - the word count shows in the bottom-right of the editor ("4 words");
  - nothing overlaps.
